name: Perfect Treasure Map
skillFull: Map Fragment Jellies appear at regular intervals. Collect enough Map Fragment Jellies to discover a hidden chest filled with Map Fragment Jellies, various Gem Jellies, and items. Level Up for more points for Gem Jellies found in the chest.
